result.summary: The page has a couple of visible layout/content issues: a restaurant name is truncated in the 'Fastest near you' list, the last visible card in 'Popular right now' is cut off at the bottom, and the favorite heart icons are styled inconsistently.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' restaurant name is truncated/clipped (shows 'Trattoria Picco' instead of the full name).
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with ellipsis, allow multi-line wrapping, or increase the card width so full merchant names are readable.

issues.description: The second card in the 'Popular right now' section is partially cut off at the bottom of the screen, making it look incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding or fully reveal the last card to make the scrollable area feel intentional rather than broken.

issues.description: The favorite heart icons are inconsistent: one is a plain outline while another sits inside a dark circular background.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon style across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.
